This older filter ignores changes below a byte threshold. It compares stored data, not visible pixels. Remove it to use the selected rule without this extra filter.
Edit this page and preview its region rules. The selector may no longer match, or the response may not be HTML. Saved history is kept.
Only matching HTML is saved. Changes outside the region or in ignored elements do not trigger alerts. Preview before saving. Leave the include selector empty to watch the whole page.

Normal checks can be scheduled from every 15 minutes to every 7 days.
